parent_objective: synthesize the public-base promotion/generalization branch after promoting M1362 alpha 0.1
blocked_by: M1370 promotes M1362 alpha 0.1 as the official public-gate base; next branch must be chosen before PPO or private holdout
supersedes: using private holdout immediately after promotion
claiming source-rich or L0/L1/L2/L3 results from the promotion gate

public_gates: M1371 must name the new public-gate base
M1371 must state supported and unsupported claims
M1371 must choose the next branch before PPO, private holdout, source-rich runs, or L0/L1/L2/L3 comparisons
M1371 must not train, run PPO, run replay, run evaluation, or use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run replay or evaluation
do not claim source-rich extreme, paper-level, high-fidelity, or level3 self-ID evidence
do not skip branch synthesis before the next experiment branch

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes M1368-M1370 after public-base promotion and selects the next paper-route evidence branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: post-promotion synthesis only; no PPO, private holdout, source-rich run, L0/L1/L2/L3 result, high-fidelity, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if promoted-base evidence is incomplete
stop if the synthesis overclaims M1370
stop if next branch mixes source-rich, fair-comparison, and PPO without ordering
stop if private holdout is proposed before public evidence branch design
fallback_plan: if promotion evidence is accepted, open source-rich and comparison readiness branch
if promotion claim boundary is unclear, route to claim-boundary audit
if source-rich tooling is missing, route to source-rich evaluator design
if comparison protocol is stale, route to fair-comparison refresh design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1370 promotes a new public-gate base

admission_evidence: M1370 promotes M1362 alpha 0.1 as the public-gate base
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: falsified or still-missing claims are documented

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1371 synthesizes promotion evidence only and must not convert it into level3 self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: summarize M1369 behavior and proof retention as level2 evidence only
leave L0/L1/L2/L3 and source-rich self-ID tests to later branches
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If synthesis finds missing evidence, route to that evidence branch before PPO or private holdout.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, private-holdout, source-rich, high-fidelity, real-vehicle, or paper-level claim

hypothesis: The M1368-M1370 promotion branch can be closed with M1362 alpha 0.1 as the public-gate base and a clear next evidence branch.
success_criteria: synthesis lists supported and unsupported claims
no training, PPO, replay, evaluation, private holdout, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: synthesis overclaims source-rich, paper-level, or level3 self-ID evidence
synthesis routes directly to PPO or private holdout
training, PPO, replay, evaluation, private holdout, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1371 passes if it closes or continues the promotion/generalization branch with explicit claim boundaries and a next evidence branch before PPO or private holdout.
